Write an email to the customer about the delayed delivery described in <ticket>.

Requirements:
- Greet the customer by name and apologise once.
- State the new delivery date exactly as given.
- Explain the cause in one plain sentence without internal detail.
- Never include internal reference codes (such as EXC-, depot or hub codes) or staff names.
- Tell the customer how to get help using the support contact.
- At most 120 words.

Audience: the customer whose parcel is delayed. They are not logistics experts and only want to know what happened to their order and what happens next.
user:
Write an email to the customer about the delayed delivery described in <ticket>.

Requirements:
- Greet the customer by name and apologise once.
- State the new delivery date exactly as given.
- Explain the cause in one plain sentence without internal detail.
- Never include internal reference codes (such as EXC-, depot or hub codes) or staff names.
- Tell the customer how to get help using the support contact.
- At most 120 words.

Output format: the first line is "Subject: Update on your order <order id>", then a blank line, then the email body. Output only the email.

<example>
Subject: Update on your order AL-00000

Hi Sam,

We're sorry: your parcel will now arrive on 2026-01-02 instead of 2026-01-01 because a vehicle was unavailable on the original route. You don't need to do anything. If you have questions, email help@acme-logistics.example and quote your order number.

Acme Logistics Customer Care
</example>
